title: Character extension roofs and ordered cup composition
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site and $G$ a profinite group, with $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$. Use internal $A$-modules, equivariant internal modules, and the coefficient universes of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-weil-size-convention], and ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $P^{-n}=P_n=A[\underline G^{n+1}]$ for $n\geq0$, and $P^i=0$ for $i>0$, with diagonal left action, differential $d_P^{-n}=\partial_n$ given by alternating deletion, $d_P^0=0$, and augmentation $e:P\to A[0]$ sending $[g]$ to $1$, as in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. Give $A$ trivial action. Shifts have $d_{P[1]}=-d_P$.

Write $Q$ for localization at quasi-isomorphisms and $C=R\Gamma_G(A[0])$. Use the canonical shifted derived adjunction $\Phi_q$ and signs $t_{p,r}$ of [lem-sfb-internal-inflation-graded-cup], so that
$$\Phi_p(x)\smile\Phi_r(y)=t_{p,r}\Phi_{p+r}(y[p]\circ x).$$
The classes $[a]:A[-1]\to C$ and unital cup product are normalized as in [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. For every additive condensed-group map $a:\underline G\to(A,+)$, form the short exact equivariant extension
$$0\longrightarrow A\xrightarrow{x\mapsto(x,0)}E_a=A\oplus A\xrightarrow{(x,y)\mapsto y}A\longrightarrow0,\qquad g(x,y)=(x+a(g)y,y).$$
Let $\delta_a:A[0]\to A[1]$ be its canonical triangle boundary in the cone convention of [lem-sfb-internal-bar-roof-adjunction]. For any equivariant cochain map $L:P\to P[1]$ whose augmented degree $-1$ component satisfies
$$eL[g_0,g_1]=a(g_0^{-1}g_1),$$
put $x_a=Q(e[1]L)Q(e)^{-1}$. Then
$$x_a=-\delta_a,\qquad \Phi_1(x_a)=-[a].$$

More generally, for $q\geq0$, additive condensed-group maps $a_1,\ldots,a_q$ and any corresponding cochain maps $L_1,\ldots,L_q$ satisfying these augmented-component equations, put $F_0=1_P$ and $F_q=L_q[q-1]\circ\cdots\circ L_1$, and $\rho_q=Q(e[q]F_q)Q(e)^{-1}$. Then
$$\rho_q=x_{a_q}[q-1]\circ\cdots\circ x_{a_1},\qquad [a_1]\smile\cdots\smile[a_q]=(-1)^q T_q\Phi_q(\rho_q),$$
where $T_0=T_1=1$ and $T_{q+1}=T_qt_{q,1}$ for $q\geq1$. The empty composition is $1_A$ and the empty cup is the unit. The signs depend only on the fixed tensor/shift convention and the degree, independently of $A,G$, the characters and the chosen cochain lifts. No projectivity of $P_n$ or underived internal-Hom acyclicity is assumed.

proof.text: Rewrite a localized roof as the shifted map of the cochain endomorphism under Q, conjugated by the isomorphism Q(P) ≅ A given by Q(e) and the canonical single comparison. Mathlib ShiftedHom.map_comp preserves shifted composition. Conjugation preserves it too: shifted e.hom followed by shifted e.inv cancels, and naturality of shift addition moves the remaining conjugating map to the endpoint. The zero-shift naturality gives the identity in degree zero. Induction on q therefore identifies the roof of the ordered lifted composite with the ordered composite of the individual roofs. This argument holds for arbitrary cochain lifts, even without any character equation. The wrapper localizedShiftedRoof contains exactly the original composite, with its composition and zero-degree equations proved generically. It is irreducible to avoid expanding concrete action-category data during subsequent algebra.

proof.text: For the cup formula use induction on q with the characters, lifts and their generator conditions generalized. At q=0 the roof is the zero-shift identity, and inflationPhiIdentity is exactly the defined empty cup. At q+1, the induction hypothesis gives the scalar (-1)^q T_q for the prefix, and degree-one normalization rewrites the final character class as minus Phi of its roof. Additivity of tensor in both variables and composition makes the resulting cup equal to -((-1)^q T_q) times the cup of the two Phi classes. Apply the chosen binary (q,1) identity and the roof-composition formula. The scalar is (-1)^(q+1) T_(q+1): at q=0 use t_(0,1)=1, and at positive q use the defining recursion T_(q+1)=T_q t_(q,1). No interchange of characters is made.
